final_message:
Configured DNS on pc1 and pointed all 40 lab PCs to it. The requested names map to their existing addresses, and `company.com` and `university.edu` have MX records pointing to pc7 and pc11 respectively. Existing connections and routes were left unchanged.

I verified the 17 host records, both MX records, and the resolver configuration against the startup files. I couldn’t run live DNS queries because the Docker daemon was inaccessible in this environment.
